parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The endpoint of the instance. Call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the instance. Call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description: The SID of the instance. Call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. Call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain this value.
